{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS157 |prevtitle=Magnificent Magnemite |nextcode=PS159 |nexttitle=Popular Pupitar |series=Gold, Silver & Crystal |colorscheme=Johto}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Silly Scyther |title_ja=VS ストライク |title_ro=VS Strike |image=PS158.png |scheme=Gold, Silver & Crystal |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 158 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|13}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 158 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|13}} |location=[[Indigo Plateau]] }} '''Silly Scyther''' (Japanese: '''VS ストライク''' ''VS {{tt|Strike|Scyther}}''), titled '''Mighty Cuts, Scyther!''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 158th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 68th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} As [[Sabrina]] prepares to return to the [[Indigo Plateau]] stage for her match, she passes by her opponent, [[Bugsy]], talking to [[Kurt]] and his granddaughter [[Maizie]] about the capture net Kurt made for Bugsy. The three of them eventually notice Sabrina, who turns to walk away. Meanwhile, [[Lt. Surge]]'s {{p|Magnemite}} delivers a {{m|Zap Cannon}} to knock out its opposition, [[Morty]]'s {{p|Misdreavus}}. Just as [[DJ Mary|Mary]] is about to declare Lt. Surge the victor, she, followed by the rest of the audience, notice with surprise that his Magnemite is also down. Morty explains that his Misdreavus had used {{m|Destiny Bond}}. Thus, Mary declares the match a draw. Morty walks up to Lt. Surge to offer his hand for a handshake, but his hand gets punched instead. Lt. Surge rudely warns Morty not to talk about the enemy he was seeking revenge on. Sabrina and Bugsy eventually commence their battle. Bugsy, noting that his type has an advantage over Sabrina's, immediately calls his {{p|Scyther}} forward to deliver a {{m|Fury Cutter}} on Sabrina's {{p|Mr. Mime}}. Bugsy switches out for his {{p|Heracross}} who delivers a {{m|Megahorn}} on the same opponent. The [[Kanto]] bench looks on with unease. Sabrina finally responds by ordering a {{m|Confusion}} from Mr. Mime, and Heracross responds by {{m|Endure|enduring}} the attack. Heracross charges forward to finish off Mr. Mime, but hits something in the way. Sabrina and her Mr. Mime tower over Bugsy and Heracross by standing on an invisible stairway. After being told that they are trapped in an invisible house with only one exit, Bugsy initially tries to locate the exit but decides on tearing down the wall, thus orders Heracross to use {{m|Take Down}}. However, Heracross uses Endure again, causing Bugsy to realize that {{m|Encore}} was being used on it. Sabrina thus has her Mr. Mime fire a {{m|Psybeam}} through the invisible walls to knock Heracross out and hand Sabrina the match, bringing Kanto back on level terms again. ==Major events== * [[Morty]]'s and [[Lt. Surge]]'s battle ends in a draw, resulting in [[Kanto]]: 1 and [[Johto]]: 2. * [[Bugsy]] loses to [[Sabrina]], resulting in Kanto: 2 and Johto: 2. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Brock]] * [[Misty]] * [[Lt.
